audience: National interoperability authority · ministry CIO · Ministry of Justice sponsor

videos.title: Why the platform needs a legal mandate
videos.message: Without the legal layer, the bus cannot lawfully carry one cross-agency message — the decree is the on-switch, not paperwork.

videos.title: Anatomy of an interoperability decree
videos.message: A sound decree is five parts; knowing them lets you brief a Ministry of Justice instead of waiting on it.

videos.title: The Explanatory Memorandum and Preamble
videos.message: Draft the case-for and the recitals with Claude from your Strategic Foundation Document — then check every claim against a real statute.

videos.title: The Draft Articles Package
videos.message: The operative articles — mandatory connection, once-only, data protection — generated against published models, every clause confirmed, not invented.

videos.title: The Cover Note and Two-Track Regulatory Memo
videos.message: Transmit the package with a specific ask, and show how the decree and the data-protection law fit together — so the decree moves, and the data-protection authority backs it instead of blocking it.

videos.title: The decree as configuration
videos.message: The finished decree authorises exactly the exchanges in your Use-Case Catalogue — read it as the legal configuration that binds the technical bus.
